thread:
anna: hey everyone, day 2 for me. trying to finish onboarding tasks but hitting a perms blocker. need Console env panel: qa admin to run onboarding flows, prod readonly for runbook review. who should approve?
jorge: welcome anna! :wave: for env-panel access we route through infra-permissions. quickest is to open a ticket and paste the manager approval line in the body. include which flags you'll touch.
anna: can someone drop a minimal ticket body i can copy?
jorge: use this minimal template:
```
Title: Env panel access - anna
Requester: anna
Manager: <mgr-name>
Environments: qa(admin), prod(readonly)
Flags: onboarding.*
Duration: 10 days
Purpose: onboarding verification + runbook checks
```
ops: note: prod readonly uses SCIM sync; infra may ask you to join the "prod-viewers" group instead of direct role assignment. expect a short delay if that group needs updating.
access-bot: verification steps after infra confirms: Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" OR API: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq . Look for "env_panel": "admin" in qa and "env_panel": "readonly" in prod.
anna: filed ticket INF-5012 and added manager approval. ping me if infra needs more context.
jorge: approved in ticket, tagging infra to expedite.
ops: infra gave QA admin, prod readonly pending SCIM sync. should finish in ~45m. i'll update when done.
anna: great, i'll hold off flag flips until you confirm. thanks!"
